summary: Frontend-only verification of UI rebuilds for Users, Low Stock, and Transactions tabs (admin@stockmgmt.com). All requested column orders, Excel-style sort/filter popovers, Export to Excel buttons, Document No click-to-dialog flow, and pagination footer (500/page) work correctly. Filter popover renders outside table bounds (overflow-visible respected, not clipped).

issues: Console a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. DialogContent in /app/frontend/src/components/DocumentDetailDialog.jsx has no DialogDescription. Non-blocking but should be fixed by adding <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby for accessibility compliance.

users_tab.sort_toggle: PASS — asc first row=Admin, desc first row='Vis Staff'
users_tab.status_filter_popover: PASS — Sort A→Z, Sort Z→A, Search, (Select All), Active/Deactivated checkboxes, Clear, Apply all visible & not clipped

transactions_tab.doc_dialog_opens_without_navigation: PASS — URL stayed on /transactions, doc-detail-dialog visible, Transfer body rendered with item table
transactions_tab.pagination_footer: Showing 50 of 50 on this page · 50 total · Page 1 of 1 · 500 / page (PASS)

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to DocumentDetailDialog's DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: DocumentDetailDialog: DialogContent has no DialogDescription — Radix UI logs a11y warning. Add a sr-only DialogDescription.
TransactionsPage: pickDocumentNo is called twice per row (in useTableSortFilter and in render). For a 500-row page this is fine but could be memoised on the row if rendering perf becomes an issue.

useTableSortFilter: filter popover uses absolute positioning inside <th>; this works because parent containers have overflow-visible. If a future change adds overflow-x-auto wrapper (TransactionsPage already wraps table in overflow-x-auto), filter popover may be clipped horizontally. In our test it rendered fine but worth noting.

exportExcel.js: column.value is called with single arg (row) but LowStockPage passes (_, idx) signature for Sl No. Currently the override re-computes idx via filteredRows.indexOf(r) which works but is O(n^2). Acceptable for typical low-stock list size.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded data (3 transfer notes, multiple racking/picking notes, 2 low-stock items, ~50 transactions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three rebuilt pages verified: column order, Excel-style sort/filter popovers (with all sub-elements), Export to Excel, Document No click→dialog flow on Transactions (incl. Esc to close, no nav), pagination (500/page), Stock In/Out sub-tabs preserve same layout. Only minor finding is a Radix DialogContent a11y warning in DocumentDetailDialog (no DialogDescription). No regressions observed in sidebar nav (Stock Transfer link still present).
